_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY — coordinates are illustrative and have not been checked. Copy this to a real
file (e.g. kansas-city-plumbing.json) and replace everything before running anything paid.
One file per market-vertical: one business category in one city. The portfolio target is
SUBMARKET GEOMETRY IS IMMUTABLE ONCE SCANNING BEGINS. Names are editable forever; centres,
radii and spacing are not. The seeder refuses to change the geometry of a submarket that has
been scanned. Before the first scan you can still revise freely, so getting these approximately
right now is fine — getting them wrong after Phase 2 starts is not.
categories vs keywords: categories drive the Outscraper listing pull (Stage A1); keywords
drive Phase 2 SERP and geogrid scanning. They often overlap. They are not the same field.
